text:
**A repeat send is stopped before reaching the vendor** if the existing record meets either of these checks:

| Refusal | Condition |
|---|---|
| `already_sent` | Upload status is `uploaded`, processing status is **not** `archived`, and the return type matches the new send. |
| `upload_in_progress` | Upload status is `waiting` or `uploading`. This check applies **across return types**. |

Both checks are scoped to the same **firm, client, contact, tax year, provider, and document ID**. See [ValidateDocuments]( /Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export/validate_documents.rb:79).

Consequently, an archived upload does not block resending. A completed upload under another return type does not trigger `already_sent`, but an upload still in flight does block it.

Rejected documents are excluded from the send. If every selected document is rejected, the service returns success with an empty `accepted_documents` list and the per-document `rejected_documents`; it exits **before calling the provider adapter**. With a mixed selection, only accepted documents proceed. See [ExportAsync#perform](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export_async.rb:53).

Other document-level refusals are `unsupported_return_type`, `unsupported_tax_year`, `unsupported_file_format`, and `file_too_large`. Payload refusals take precedence over the duplicate/in-flight checks.
